description.value: Mykonos Pizza and Spaghetti House is a sit-down restaurant in Penticton, BC, offering pizza and pasta in a retail-building setting. It sits near the heart of Penticton, a popular hub on the Kettle Valley Rail Trail and Okanagan cycling routes, making it a convenient stop for touring cyclists passing through town.
